subject: website
name: ETHNET
summary: ETHNET, a Spasm-protocol search and feed page. It is served as written (readable script plus the vendored ethers library), so the page is its own public source (no licence file), and it runs no third-party code on its own; its previews are sandboxed frames filled only on a click, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it loads Google Fonts and its posts from the ethnet.work server.

connections.name: ethnet.work API
connections.note: Latest posts are fetched when the page opens; the page shows what this server returns.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
